records.text: Owens said Andrew Kolvet only appeared to be live in Arizona on The Charlie Kirk Show with Kash Patel; the show had been prerecorded while Kolvet was in Washington's Eisenhower Executive Office Building the day before the Epstein files were released.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: that strange coincidence of the day before the Epstein files were released, Andrew Kolvet appeared to be live in studio on the Charlie Kirk show hosting of all people, Kash Patel. ... How odd. But he wasn't. He wasn't live. This was pre-recorded. And actually, Andrew Kolvet was five hours via a flight away in Washington, D.C., in the executive office building. ... And yet he's appearing as though he's actually in Arizona. And then sure enough, the next day. The Epstein files get dropped.

verification.notes: The episode itself says records were being requested through FOIA. Live searches found the January 29, 2026 Charlie Kirk Show episode with Andrew Kolvet and Kash Patel, but no released White House visitor record, Secret Service record, production metadata, or reliable report proving that the broadcast was prerecorded while Kolvet was in the Eisenhower Executive Office Building. The compound claim remains unverifiable.
